Headline: ONE WEEK LEFT — DON’T MISS THE DUAL INVESTMENT CAMPAIGN!
Start: not stated · End: not stated
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
During the campaign, users who register on the campaign page and reach the specified cumulative Dual Investment subscription amount can claim the corresponding Earn Rate-Up Coupon with up to 100% Bonus APR.
Cumulative Subscription Amount | Rate-Up APR | Max Principal for Rate-Up | Rate-Up Period | Coupons per Eligible User | Total Coupons Available
≥ 100 USDT | 50% | 10 USDT | 3 days | 1 coupon | 500
≥ 1,000 USDT | 50% | 100 USDT | 3 days | 1 coupon | 300
≥ 10,000 USDT | 80% | 5000 USDT | 3 days | 1 coupon | 100
≥ 50,000 USDT | 100% | 2,500 USDT | 3 days | 1 coupon | 50
## Stake KCS to unlock exclusive KCS Loyalty Program benefits
Stake ≥1 KCS to join the KCS Loyalty Program and enjoy exclusive benefits such as Spotlight token sale privileges, Earn yield boosts, and more. The more KCS you stake and the higher your KCS ratio in total assets, the higher your tier will be from K1 to K4, unlocking even greater benefits.
About Dual Investment
Dual Investment is a non-principal-protected, high-yield structured financial product. Based on their market outlook, users can choose to sell crypto at a higher target price or buy crypto at a lower target price on a specified future date while earning returns.
Product Direction | Sell High | Buy Low
Suitable For | Crypto holders seeking returns; users who want to sell crypto above the current market price | Stablecoin holders seeking returns; users who want to buy crypto below the current market price
Investment Assets | BTC, ETH, SOL and other supported tokens | USDT, BTC, or ETH
Estimated APR | Up to 250% APR | Up to 250% APR
Available assets, target prices, product terms, and APRs are subject to the Dual Investment subscription page.

Exchange/platform: XT.com
Headline: XT On-Chain Earn New Token Launch: Limited-Time Boosted Rates for BNB and GRAM, Enjoy Up to 20% APR!
Start: 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-27T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
The XT On-Chain Earn New Asset Campaign is coming soon! During the campaign, XT Earn will introduce two new staking products, BNB and GRAM, to its On-Chain Earn section. Users who participate in the designated staking products can enjoy exclusive promotional APRs for a limited time!
## 1. Campaign Period
November 20, 2026 – November 27, 2026
## 2. Campaign Products and Reward Rules
During the campaign, users can visit XT [Earn] – [On-Chain Earn] to participate in staking and enjoy the corresponding promotional APR.
Asset | Campaign Product | Total Campaign Cap | Promotional APR
BNB | BNB On-Chain Staking | 1,000 BNB | 3%
GRAM | GRAM On-Chain Staking | 200,000 GRAM | 20%
## 3. How to Participate
Join the XT On-Chain Earn campaign in just three simple steps!
## Step 1: Prepare Your Assets
Log in to your XT account and ensure that you have sufficient BNB or GRAM in your account.
## Step 2: Visit the On-Chain Earn Section
Go to the [Earn] page on XT, enter the [On-Chain Earn] section, and select the corresponding BNB or GRAM staking product.
## Step 3: Subscribe and Start Earning
Enter your desired staking amount and review the product APR, staking period, and relevant terms. Complete your subscription to participate in the campaign and start earning the corresponding rewards.
## 4. Campaign Rules and Important Notes
This campaign is exclusively available for the newly listed BNB and GRAM products in XT On-Chain Earn.
Campaign product quotas are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis until fully subscribed.
The campaign APR represents an annualized rate. Actual rewards are calculated based on the user's eligible staking amount and participation period.
Rewards are calculated based on the actual eligible staking period using the following formula: Staked Amount × Promotional APR × Eligible Staking Days ÷ 365.
The actual reward distribution schedule and settlement method during the campaign are subject to the information displayed on the product page.
The staking, redemption, and arrival times for BNB and GRAM are subject to the rules of the respective on-chain protocols and the information displayed on the product page.
Digital assets are subject to price volatility. On-chain staking may involve smart contract, validator, and liquidity risks. Please fully understand the relevant risks before participating.
If any user is found to have obtained campaign rewards through multiple accounts, fraudulent transactions, or other prohibited means, XT reserves the right to disqualify the user from the campaign and take action regarding any improperly obtained rewards in accordance with platform rules.

Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Introducing Binance P2P Academy Latam Program
Start: 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-31T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
We are launching the end-of-year Binance P2P Academy Latam, a six-week educational program designed to help P2P users in LATAM grow their operations, deepen their knowledge of Binance P2P, and unlock advanced features. Participants who complete the program and its challenges can get access to an exclusive pool of rewards to be disclosed week by week during each live session.
Campaign Period: 2026-11-20 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-31 23:59 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Step 1. Enroll in the Bootcamp. Fill out the form, using an account that has completed KYC verification.
Step 2. Attend the weekly sessions. Join the live sessions on Binance Square and the Binance official channels.
Step 3. Complete the weekly challenges as announced.
Step 4. Reach the Leaderboard. Participants who progress through the program and complete the challenges are ranked on the Graduation Leaderboard to get an exclusive invitation to our End-of-Year event in Santa Cruz de Bolivia in December 2026.
## Program Contents & Schedule
Time | Program Segment | Format
2026-11-20 | Event is announced and enrollment open | Form
Monday, 2026-11-23 | Welcome to Binance P2P Academy. | Live on Binance Square
Monday, 2026-11-30 | Learning the basics: How Binance P2P works, and how to create and take p2p ads | Live on Binance Square
Thursday, 2026-12-03 | KOL Panel: Safety best practices for P2P users | Live on Binance Square
Monday, 2026-12-07 | Introducing Binance Lifestyle: What it is, how to buy with USDT, and what can be found on the Marketplace | Live on Binance Square
Monday, 2026-12-14 | Introduction to Binance Merchant Program and badge system: How to use merchant advanced features and join the VIP merchant program | Live on Binance Square
Wednesday, 2026-11-16 | Live event and early bird graduation | Live on Binance Square
Thursday, 2026-11-31 | Program wrap up and leaderboard final spots closure | Exclusive rewards and prizes will be distributed based on each session’s individual challenge and timeline. The final ranking will wrap up by 2026-12-31 and results will be announced up to two weeks after the program closure.
## Who Can Join
The Program is open to all eligible Binance P2P users in LATAM, including:
All P2P users interested in arbitrage operations
Former applicants of any p2p merchant program
Verified Basic Merchants who want to scale their operations and increase their volume
Established merchants who want to scale their operations and learn about growing opportunities with Binance P2P
## Event Formats & Channels
Educational content distributed via email, inMail, and app push
Live online events hosted on Binance Square
End-of-year live events hosted in Santa Cruz de Bolivia
## Results Evaluation & Timeline
Applications open on: 2026-11-20
Opening launch session: 2026-11-23
Weekly sessions: As mentioned in the table above
Final challenge close: 2026-12-31
Closing event (Bolivia): To be announced
Program closure: Final ranking will wrap up by 2026-12-31 and results will be announced via email, inMail, and app push up to two weeks after the program closure.
## Terms and Conditions
Only users who registered before 2026-12-31 00:00 (UTC) can participate in program challenges.
Users will be eligible for program rewards only if they’ve completed the program missions by 2026-12-31 00:00 (UTC).
Eligible new users are required to complete KYC to receive rewards from this activity.
Illegally bulk registered accounts or sub-accounts shall not be eligible to participate or receive any rewards.
Rewards are limited and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Users may only claim the rewards after completing the respective missions.
Users will not be able to participate in this activity once all rewards are distributed.
The actual value of the reward received is subject to change due to market fluctuation.
Token voucher rewards will be distributed within two weeks after the end date of the program as stated above. Users may check their rewards via Profile > Rewards Hub.
The validity period for the token voucher is set at 14 days from the day of distribution. Learn how to redeem a token voucher.
Binance accounts can only be used by the account registrants. Binance reserves the right to suspend, freeze or cancel the use of Binance accounts by persons other than account registrants.
Additional promotion terms and conditions can be accessed here.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
Thank you for using Binance!
